body: RTL bubble text was right-aligned by the SHARED renderer, not by the cell. ChatNativeAgentTextRenderer.makeParagraphStyle sets style.alignment = isRtl ? .right : .natural, and an explicit paragraph alignment outranks UILabel.textAlignment — so ChatListCell.configure's messageLabel.textAlignment = .left was dead code for every Farsi/Arabic body. Fixed in parseBubbleMarkdown (chat-bubble path only, agent surface untouched): re-enumerate .paragraphStyle and force .left when isRTL(text), keeping baseWritingDirection = .rightToLeft for shaping. Alignment does not change measured size, so no bubbleLayoutRevision bump is needed for this.
